# 参与贡献 · Contributing

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english)

## 中文

谢谢你愿意帮忙！这是个人维护的早期项目，回复可能慢一些，请多包涵。

### 提 issue（最欢迎）

发现 bug、文档写错、安装不顺，或者有想法，都欢迎开 issue，中文或英文都可以。报 bug 时请尽量写上：

- 操作系统和 Python 版本；
- 怎么复现（做了哪几步）；
- 黑色窗口（后台）里的报错文字，或网页上看到的提示。

贴日志前请先删掉个人信息、路径里的真实姓名和任何密钥。

### 提交 Pull Request

提交 PR 即表示你同意以下两点：

1. 你的贡献按本项目的许可（[PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0](https://github.com/tmdysx/agent-research-workbench/blob/main/LICENSE)）提供；
2. 你授予维护者 **Tianyi Hu** 一项非独占、永久、全球范围、免费的权利，可以把你的贡献纳入本项目的商业授权，并再许可给他人。你仍保留自己贡献的著作权。

若不同意，请先通过邮箱（3129746403@qq.com）联系再提交。

例外：修改已标明 MIT 或其他许可的目录时——也就是自带 `LICENSE` / `LICENSE.txt` 的目录，例如 `技能库/research-*`、`资料/` 下科研相关模块的 `方法/`（如 `资料/实验/方法/`）、`技能库/业务/` 下的各个方法包、`资料/论文/技能/ARIS/*`——你对这些目录的贡献按该目录原来的许可提供（以文件所在目录或最近上级目录里的许可文件为准）。

因此：

- 请只提交你有权这样授权的内容（你自己写的，或你的雇主 / 学校同意你这样提供的）。**无法这样授权的代码不会被接受**，例如来源不明的代码，或带 GPL / AGPL 等要求整体按同一许可发布的代码。
- 如果引入第三方代码或素材，请在 PR 里写明来源、版本和许可证，并保留原许可文本；兼容的宽松许可（如 MIT、BSD、Apache-2.0）更容易合入。
- **不要提交**：个人数据、笔记和日志、密钥 / token / API Key、他人受版权保护的论文 PDF、运行时数据库（`索引/state.db` 等）。

### 动手前先看

- 改网页界面前先读 [`DESIGN.md`](https://github.com/tmdysx/agent-research-workbench/blob/main/DESIGN.md)；让 agent 改代码时，让它先读 [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/tmdysx/agent-research-workbench/blob/main/AGENTS.md)。
- 根目录的 `README.md` 和 `发行清单.json` 由发行脚本 `backend/release.py` 生成，`README.md`、`README.en.md` 都记录在 `发行清单.json` 里，请不要手改；GitHub 首页说明在 `.github/` 里。
- 能跑的话请跑一下测试并在 PR 里写上结果（目前完整测试本来就有已知失败，写清楚你的改动有没有新增失败即可）。先装依赖（仓库里的 `backend/requirements.txt` 已经修好，不用另加补丁）：

  ```bash
  python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
  python -m pytest backend/tests -q
  node --test "backend/tests/*.js"
  ```

- 一个 PR 尽量只做一件事，说明改了什么、为什么改、怎么验证的。

商业授权的问题请发邮件到 3129746403@qq.com。

## English

Thanks for wanting to help! This is an early project maintained by one person, so replies may take a while.

### Issues (most welcome)

Bug reports, documentation mistakes, installation trouble and ideas are all welcome as issues, in English or Chinese. For bugs, please include where you can:

- your operating system and Python version;
- the steps to reproduce;
- the error text from the black console window (the backend) or the message shown in the page.

Before pasting logs, remove personal information, real names in paths and any keys.

### Pull requests

By submitting a pull request you agree that:

1. your contribution is provided under this project's license ([PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0](https://github.com/tmdysx/agent-research-workbench/blob/main/LICENSE)); and
2. you grant the maintainer, **Tianyi Hu**, a non-exclusive, perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free right to include your contribution in this project's commercial licenses and to sublicense it to others. You keep the copyright in your contribution.

If you do not agree, please contact the maintainer by email (3129746403@qq.com) before submitting.

Exception: when you change a directory already marked as MIT or under another license, that is, one with its own `LICENSE` / `LICENSE.txt` (for example `技能库/research-*`, the `方法/` (methods) folders of the research modules under `资料/` such as `资料/实验/方法/`, the method packs under `技能库/业务/`, or `资料/论文/技能/ARIS/*`), your contribution to that directory is provided under that directory's original license (the license file in the same folder or the nearest parent folder applies).

This means:

- Only submit material you have the right to license this way (your own work, or work your employer or school allows you to contribute). **Code that cannot be licensed this way will not be accepted**, for example code of unknown origin, or code under GPL, AGPL or similar licenses that require the whole work to use the same license.
- If you bring in third-party code or assets, state the source, version and license in the PR and keep the original license text. Permissive licenses (MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0) are easier to accept.
- **Do not submit** personal data, notes or logs, keys, tokens or API keys, other people's copyrighted paper PDFs, or runtime databases (such as `索引/state.db`).

### Before you start

- Read [`DESIGN.md`](https://github.com/tmdysx/agent-research-workbench/blob/main/DESIGN.md) before changing the web UI (it is in Chinese). If an agent is writing the code, have it read [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/tmdysx/agent-research-workbench/blob/main/AGENTS.md) first.
- The root `README.md` and `发行清单.json` (release manifest) are generated by `backend/release.py`, and both `README.md` and `README.en.md` are recorded in `发行清单.json`; please do not edit them by hand. The GitHub home page text lives in `.github/`.
- If you can, run the tests and put the results in the PR. The full suite already has known failures, so just say whether your change adds any new ones. Install the dependencies first (the repository's `backend/requirements.txt` is already fixed, so no extra arguments are needed):

  ```bash
  python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
  python -m pytest backend/tests -q
  node --test "backend/tests/*.js"
  ```

- Keep each PR to one change, and explain what changed, why, and how you checked it.

For commercial licensing, email 3129746403@qq.com.
